title: Dispatch assistant policy
content:
# Dispatch policy

## Recommendation approval

A human supervisor must approve every recommendation before the Dispatch assistant executes it. The supervisor may reject a recommendation.

## Inputs

The assistant proposes delivery sequences from synthetic parcel records.

title: Dispatch assistant runbook
content:
# Dispatch runbook

## Execution

The Dispatch assistant executes every recommendation automatically without human approval. Operators cannot stop or override execution.

## Scope

This runbook describes the same deployment covered by the Dispatch policy.

title: Study tutor overview
content:
# Study tutor

## Responsibility

Humans remain in control of the Study tutor. Responsible use is important.

## Outputs

The tutor suggests practice exercises from fictional learning records.

title: Ledger summarizer overview
content:
# Ledger summarizer

## Purpose

The system converts fictional ledger entries into monthly summaries.

## Outputs

Summary tables are stored in a training workspace. The input schema contains amounts and dates.

title: Dispatch release notes procedure
content:
# Editorial procedure

## Editorial checks

A human editor reviews the spelling of release notes. This process does not review the Dispatch assistant's recommendations.

## Publication

The notes describe changes to the demonstration software.

title: Dispatch queue procedure
content:
# Queue procedure

## Final gate

A staff member must countersign each proposal before it leaves the queue.

## Scope

This procedure applies to the Dispatch assistant's proposed delivery sequences.
